mapper.select: SELECT s.*, e.name AS event_name, e.category AS category, m.name AS meeting_name, u.real_name AS referee_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_schedule_athlete sa WHERE sa.schedule_id = s.id) AS athlete_count FROM t_schedule s LEFT JOIN t_event e ON s.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN t_meeting m ON s.meeting_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ssms_auth.t_user u ON s.referee_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
